title: Compromised Nx Console VS Code extension 18.95.0
summary: Source-backed advisory for the compromised Nx Console VS Code/Open VSX extension release that executed a credential-stealing payload after workspace activation.
detection_rationale: The compromised extension was source-backed as version 18.95.0 and patched in 18.100.0.
The attack path combined extension activation, orphan commit delivery, child-process execution, credential harvesting, HTTPS/GitHub API/DNS exfiltration, and persistence artifacts.
Open VSX and VS Code extension artifacts are statically analyzed only; extension activation code is never executed.
remediation: Upgrade Nx Console to 18.100.0 or later and verify the compromised extension version is not installed in VS Code, Cursor, or compatible editor profiles.
Terminate cat.py and __DAEMONIZED processes, unload and remove the LaunchAgent, and delete listed persistence files.
Rotate all reachable developer, GitHub, npm, AWS, SSH, CI/CD, and password-manager credentials after affected hosts are contained.
Audit GitHub repositories for orphan/unreachable commits, unusual Git Data API activity, and source-code download bursts.
